purpose: Map the intelligent-reader and consciousness additions onto exact canonical R1 reader locations without yet mutating the frozen source files.

placements.placement: after the existing levels-of-selection/evolutionary-individuality discussion and before the chapter handoff
placements.content: Pattern → Organization → Integration → Individuality evidence-barrier ladder
placements.reason: Act IV already contains a three-stage Pattern → Organization → Individuality ladder. Promotion must reconcile the book to one four-stage canonical ladder rather than create competing ladders.

placements.placement: near What We Have Earned / final boundary synthesis
placements.content: Useful higher-level variable does not automatically establish a new individual
placements.reason: Chapter 14 and Chapter 15 already make the useful-level/non-individual distinction. Chapter 6 should seed it compactly, not repeat the later prosecution.

placements.placement: immediately after Operational Definition and before Who Owns the Capability?
placements.content: SIGNAL ≠ INFORMATION ≠ INTEGRATION ≠ INTELLIGENCE ≠ AGENCY ≠ CONSCIOUSNESS plus compact consciousness boundary
placements.reason: The existing text says intelligence is not consciousness but does not yet give consciousness enough reader-facing space.

placements.placement: after The Title Is Intentionally Dangerous and before Functions Move Outside Bodies
placements.reason: The null should compete before the strongest civilization analogy accumulates.

placements.placement: after Four Models Enter and immediately before The Eleven Tests
placements.content: Resemblance generates hypotheses. Mechanism generates evidence. Prediction separates models.
placements.reason: This is the point where analogy becomes explicit comparative model selection.

placements.content: Now Try to Kill It adversarial-reader transition
placements.reason: The Eleven Tests should be introduced as attempts to defeat the stronger hypothesis, not as an organism checklist.

placements.placement: immediately before The Hypothesis Without the Imagery
placements.content: Macroscopic Life as research program; civilization as candidate rather than predetermined answer
placements.reason: Chapter 16 already states the hypothesis conservatively; this insertion should clarify scope without delaying the final verdict.

placements.placement: fold into placement C rather than create a second consciousness section
placements.content: Individuality ≠ consciousness; component epistemic asymmetry; consciousness is downstream and separately testable
placements.reason: One compact section is sufficient for Book One; the full consciousness module remains research-layer material.

canonicalReconciliation.existingActIVLadder: MACROSCOPIC PATTERN → MACROSCOPIC ORGANIZATION → HIGHER-ORDER INDIVIDUALITY
canonicalReconciliation.newCanonicalLadder: MACROSCOPIC PATTERN → MACROSCOPIC ORGANIZATION → INTEGRATION → HIGHER-ORDER INDIVIDUALITY
canonicalReconciliation.rule: There must be only one canonical evidentiary ladder in the reader manuscript after promotion.

requiredReaderDoctrine: A component may participate in a conscious whole without representing the whole's experience.
Epistemic asymmetry is not evidence that a higher-order consciousness exists.
Do not ask whether the whole is conscious until the evidence has first earned the right to treat it as a whole.

nextGate: sentence-level burden matrix and exact replacement text for the affected R1 passages
